name: Forsaken Rift
description: It is said that in ancient times, people would venture into the valley to seek out the ancient tree on the altar. They would whisper their secrets into the tree hollow, relieving themselves of the burden of keeping the secrets to themselves. The Forsaken Rift is filled with such long-forgotten secrets.

tabs.name: Domain of Mastery: Frosted Altar I
tabs.description:
Massive Cryo energy is coursing through this freezing ancient sacrificial altar.
You shall earn Talent level-up materials, if — and only if — you can pass the trial.
